words.gloss_range: masculine singular definite relative pronoun continuing the prior divine description; it subordinates the following verbs rather than starting an independent report
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّذِى}} ({{tr:alladhī}}) makes the ayah lean back across the boundary: its antecedent is already supplied by the prior Lord-title, so the new line does not begin as a detached report. Because the referent is already identified, the relative does not introduce an indefinite "one who"; it specifies the known Lord through the acts that follow. The relative frame gathers both following perfect verbs into one descriptive clause, turning creation and proportioning into evidence attached to that referent. It also shifts the discourse from the direct command of 87:1 into third-person evidence for why that command has its object.

topics.headline: relative pronoun pulls the prior title forward
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that 87:2 is syntactically dependent on 87:1, not a fresh sentence detached from the prior Lord-title.
topics.reason: The attachment evidence marks the relative clause as continuing the prior divine description and warns against adding a new explanatory noun.

topics.headline: both verbs become one evidentiary relative clause

topics.reason: The local syntax makes the first verb the predicate of the relative clause and coordinates the second verb inside the same clause.

topics.headline: command register turns into narrated evidence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the discourse turn from direct address in 87:1 to reported divine action in 87:2.
topics.reason: The relative pronoun introduces third-person perfect verbs under the prior command frame.

words.gloss_range: completed active creating or originating with the object deliberately unspoken; the local pair keeps measure and formation pressure inside the act without activating unrelated root branches
words.root_gloss_range: root range includes measuring and proportioning, originating and bringing into being, formed constitution, disposition, worthiness, allotted share, and several specialized branches; this ayah selects measured origination under an objectless perfect verb
words.prose: {{ar:خَلَقَ}} ({{tr:khalaqa}}) is an active perfect verb under the relative frame, so creation is presented as an accomplished ground for praise and the acting subject remains the prior divine referent. Its expected object is not named; that compression lets createdness stay broad rather than narrowing the clause to one patient, especially against pronoun-explicit parallels such as 82:7. The root pressure is not bare production: {{ar:خ ل ق}} ({{tr:kh-l-q}}) carries measure, fashioning, and determinate make, and the following sequel makes that measured origination visible as ordered fitness. The Form I verb begins with direct creation rather than reflexive self-formation or a static agent-title, while the paired sequence and formulaic parallels such as 75:38, 82:7, and 87:3 show a common creation verb becoming locally marked as the first half of a creation-to-proportion pattern. Even the rougher opening sound can help the listener feel the movement from origination into later smoothing, though the grammar and pairing carry the main force.

topics.headline: active perfect grounds praise in accomplished agency
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that creation is presented as a completed act of the same relative antecedent, not as a process or passive event.
topics.reason: The word is a Form I active perfect with a third-person masculine singular subject controlled by the relative pronoun.

topics.headline: omitted object keeps creation unrestricted
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verse refuses to name a single created patient, letting the act range over the created domain.
topics.reason: The local frame marks the transitive verb with no expressed object, while variants or parallels with explicit pronouns serve as contrast rather than replacing the canonical compression.

topics.headline: making and measuring survive inside creation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that creation is not pictured as raw production; the root pressure and sequel make it measured origination open to proportion.
topics.reason: V4 supports measuring and originating branches for the root, but local grammar and the paired sequel select measured creation rather than unrelated branches such as false fabrication, perfume, or worn fabric.

topics.headline: Form I begins before derived adjustment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices how the morphology distributes the work: direct creation comes first, then explicit causative proportioning follows.
topics.reason: The first verb is unaugmented Form I, while the second verb is Form II; the contrast is local and does not require importing every other root form.

topics.headline: first half of a recognized creation-proportion sequence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the common creation verb becoming locally marked because it begins a concentrated creation-to-proportion sequence, with concrete parallels such as 75:38 and the next pair in 87:3.
topics.reason: The contextual profile shows the root pair concentrated with the following verb, and the CRITICAL rows provide concrete formula references including 75:38 and 87:3.

topics.headline: opening articulation supports the move toward smoothing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices an audible transition from the textured first verb toward the smoother following act, while grammar remains the main evidence.
topics.reason: The sound observation coheres with the local semantic movement, but it is treated as supporting texture rather than independent proof.

words.gloss_range: coordinating particle with close sequential and consequential force; it binds the second perfect verb to the first while preserving their distinction
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) is the hinge between the two perfect verbs. It does more than add a second predicate: it makes the next act follow closely from creation, so sequence and consequence remain live together. The chosen connector keeps the acts linked but distinct, neither collapsing them into an asyndetic stack nor treating proportioning as a loose extra beside creation. The particle also keeps the same subject across the change of action, preserving one continuous agency. Because it is bound to the following verb in speech and writing, the sequel is heard as attached rather than isolated, and the same fa-linked shape prepares the reader for the matching pattern in 87:3.

topics.headline: close sequence becomes consequence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that proportioning is not merely another action after creation; it follows from creation as its close fulfillment.
topics.reason: The local attachment marks the second verb as sequenced after the first, and the CRITICAL rows correctly preserve both sequential and consequential force.

topics.headline: the particle changes the action, not the agent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices one continuous divine agency carrying creation into ordering.
topics.reason: Both verbs share third-person masculine singular agreement under the same relative antecedent.

topics.headline: proclitic shape makes dependency audible
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the short bound particle makes the transition compact in sound as well as syntax.
topics.reason: The particle is prefixed orthographically and phonetically to the following verb, supporting the hinge effect without replacing the syntactic evidence.

topics.headline: first fa-link anticipates the next pair
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this local hinge also starts a same-surah pattern of first act plus fa-linked sequel that continues in 87:3.
topics.reason: The same-surah echo is concrete in 87:3, while the local particle still governs only the second verb of 87:2.

words.gloss_range: active Form II proportioning, making even, making fit, and completing after creation; the object is omitted so the created domain remains recoverable rather than individually named
words.root_gloss_range: root range includes equality, equivalence, straightness, sound completion, settling or rising in other constructions, direction toward, maturity, middle fairness, otherness, and specialized idioms; this ayah selects transitive factitive proportioning and completion
words.prose: {{ar:سَوَّىٰ}} ({{tr:sawwā}}) is the ayah's landing word: an active Form II perfect that makes proportioning an effected act by the same subject who created. Its object is again unspoken, so the patient is recovered from the created domain rather than narrowed to a single named thing; the pronoun-explicit parallel in 82:7 sharpens that canonical breadth. The root field of {{ar:س و ي}} ({{tr:s-w-y}}) gives equality, straightness, and sound completion, but local grammar selects transitive making fit: the created form is arranged into fitting relation as a sound whole, not merely smoothed on the surface and not made into intransitive self-settlement. As the second verb, it resolves the fa-hinge, completes the creation-proportion formula attested in 82:7, and looks ahead to the next ordered pair in 87:3. Its doubled sound and long close add audible pressure to active calibration, while the main payoff remains ordered fitness at the end of the ayah.

topics.headline: Form II makes balance an effected act
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that proportion is made by the same acting subject, not merely discovered as a state already present.
topics.reason: The local word is an active Form II perfect with the same third-person masculine singular subject as the first verb.

topics.headline: omitted object lets the created domain carry the patient role
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final verb does not name one proportioned object; it lets whatever was created supply the recoverable patient.
topics.reason: The frame marks the verb as transitive in sense with no overt object, matching the first verb's compressed argument structure.

topics.headline: equality and soundness become fitted completion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that proportioning means bringing created form into fitting relation and sound completion, not merely smoothing a surface.
topics.reason: V4 supports equality and sound completion branches, while the post-creation active Form II frame narrows them to transitive proportioning and excludes unrelated branches as local meanings.

topics.headline: closing verb completes the creation-proportion sequence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah does not stop at creation; it lands on ordered fitness and then anticipates the matching ordered pair in 87:3.
topics.reason: The word is coordinated as the second verb after creation, and CRITICAL gives concrete parallels including 82:7 and the next pair in 87:3.

topics.headline: pronoun-explicit parallel sharpens local breadth
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that 82:7 individualizes the patient with a pronoun, while 87:2 leaves proportioning broader by omitting it.
topics.reason: The parallel in 82:7 is concrete and useful as contrast, but it does not replace the canonical object omission in 87:2.

topics.headline: gemination and long close support active calibration
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the doubled sound and lingering close reinforce the felt pressure of making even at the ayah's end.
topics.reason: The prosodic rows cohere with the Form II and closure position, but they remain supporting texture rather than a separate semantic proof.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Creation as measured leveling before guidance.** Lexical evidence: خ ل ق B001/B003 (measuring and complete form), س و ي B002/B006 (straight completion and even middle), ق د ر B001/B005 in 87:3. Structural cue: خلق فسوى is immediately followed by قدر فهدى. Assigned role: "created" supplies measured form; "proportioned" makes that form internally straight enough to receive direction. Abductive move: guidance requires prior fitted structure. Reading change: the ayah reads less as two generic divine acts and more as the first stage in an engineering sequence: measure, straighten, assign, guide.

2. **Moral/temperamental formation.** Lexical evidence: خ ل ق B004 (inner disposition and character), س و ي B002 (sound character), ز ك و B002 in 87:14 (purity/rectitude), ذ ك ر B003/B009 in 87:9-10. Structural cue: the created/proportioned subject is later divided by remembrance, fear, avoidance, and purification. Assigned role: created form includes the creature's moral aptness, not only body. Abductive move: later responsiveness to reminder presupposes an inwardly configured receptacle. Reading change: "proportioned" activates psychological and ethical straightening.

3. **Smoothed surface awaiting inscription.** Lexical evidence: خ ل ق B008 (smooth level surface), س و ي B009 (wide/smooth open ground), ق ر ء B001/B002 and ص ح ف B001/B002 later. Structural cue: bodily/earthly forming precedes recitation and sheets. Assigned role: smoothing becomes preparation for legibility, like leveling a surface before marks can hold. Abductive move: physical surface images can analogize to memory and scripture as surfaces that retain order. Reading change: the ayah becomes a pre-literacy image of making a form readable.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The closing صحف made the "smooth/level surface" branches of خ ل ق and س و ي more salient: creation and proportioning can be read as preparing the world/person as a legible sheet. 87:14 then turned that formed legibility inward as purification.

reader_b.activated_readings_md:
1. **Creation as measured formation followed by internal straightening.** Lexical evidence: خلق B001 measuring/proportioning and B002 originating; سوي B002 internal straightness and sound completion. Structural cue: the فـ sequence makes "created" move directly into "made even/sound." Assigned role: خلق initiates the entity; سوي completes and straightens it. Abductive move: the packet supplies two verbs and formation branches; I infer a two-stage mechanism from origin to proportion. Reading change: creation is not bare production; it includes aftercare of shape and inner order.

2. **Formation as preparation for guidance.** Lexical evidence: سوي B008 aiming toward a person/direction; قدر B005 arranging by estimate and هدي B001 guidance in 87:3. Structural cue: 87:2 and 87:3 are parallel relative clauses, each with a فـ-result. Assigned role: "settling/straightening" equips the creature to receive a measured path. Abductive move: the packet gives consecutive clauses; I infer that physical/structural completion enables directional guidance. Reading change: the ayah reads as making beings guidable, not merely symmetrical.

3. **Hidden smooth-ground and pasture activation.** Lexical evidence: خلق B008 smooth/level surface; سوي B009 wide smooth open ground; مرعى in 87:4 with رعي B001 grazing/pasture. Structural cue: "made level/sound" precedes the bringing out of pasture. Assigned role: the forming verb also prepares an ecological surface. Abductive move: the packet supplies level-surface branches and pasture; I infer that land-readiness is one concrete arena of the creating/settling action. Reading change: "He created and made even" can include the terrain of life, not only bodies.

4. **Character formation under lordly nurture.** Lexical evidence: خلق B004 inner disposition/character; ربب B002 nurture/completion in 87:1; زكو B002 purity/rectitude in 87:14. Structural cue: the surah later shifts from cosmic formation to moral purification. Assigned role: خلق's character branch bridges created form and purified conduct. Abductive move: the packet gives character, nurture, and purification; I infer that "made even" also points toward rectified moral capacity. Reading change: the ayah becomes anthropological as well as cosmological: formed beings are fitted for ethical purification.
reader_b.retrospective_surprises_md: 87:14 made the moral branch more visible: تزكى looks like a later human answer to the earlier divine تسوية. 87:4-5 also surprised the ayah by showing that formed greenery can become refuse, so "made even" does not mean static permanence.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Creation is measured before it is completed.** `خ ل ق/B001` supplies measuring and proportioning before action, and `س و ي/B002` supplies straightening and sound completion. The near repetition in 87:3, `قَدَّرَ فَهَدَىٰ`, separates a two-stage mechanism: prior specification, then completed form, followed by assigned measure and course. `خَلَقَ` sets the plan and `سَوَّىٰ` realizes a balanced result. I infer this division of labor from the parallel `فـ` sequences. The ayah reads less as two synonyms and more as design brought to finished integrity.
2. **Formation includes an unseen interior.** `خ ل ق/B004` gives inner disposition and character, while `خ ل ق/B003` and `س و ي/B002` cover visible, well-proportioned form. The later contrast in 87:7 between `ٱلْجَهْرَ` and `مَا يَخْفَىٰ` supplies the structural inside/outside pair. The hidden-disposition branch assigns creation an inward object alongside outward shape. I infer that the maker’s knowledge of both domains permits both to belong to the forming act. The ayah consequently reads as integration of exterior form and interior capacity, not bodily shaping alone.
3. **The clause can also prepare an ecological surface.** `خ ل ق/B008` supplies a smooth, level surface, and `س و ي/B009` a broad or smooth tract of ground. Immediate emergence of `ٱلْمَرْعَىٰ` in 87:4 makes terrain the material cue. These branches give the two verbs the role of preparing a stable substrate from which pasture can appear. I infer the enabling arrow from the sequence; the ayah leaves the created object unstated. The reading expands from forming organisms to making an inhabitable, productive field.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 87:4 made the smooth-ground branches of both roots unexpectedly concrete by placing pasture immediately after the unsupplied object of creation. More importantly, 87:7’s manifest/hidden pair corrected an exclusively exterior reading: the completed form can include an inward disposition known with its outward shape.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak anlatımı, nesnenin kesilmesi ya da işlenmesi öncesinde ölçülmesini ve sınırlarının uygun biçimde belirlenmesini ortak çekirdek olarak verir. Deri örneği bu işlemi somutlaştırır; yoktan var etme ve yalan uydurma anlamları bu dalın parçası değildir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, eylemden önceki ölçme ve sınır belirleme aşamasıyla sınırlıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın ölçme ve biçme anlamını karşılar; başka dallardaki kalıplaşmış kullanımlar buraya taşınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir nesneyi kesme ya da uygulama öncesinde ölçüp sınırlarını uygun ve düzgün biçimde belirlemektir.

facets.statement: Nesnenin ölçüsü ve sınırları yapılacak işten önce belirlenir.
Bir deri parçasını kesmeden önce tuluma göre ölçmek bu işlemin örneğidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, anlamı ölçme, oranlama ve kesmeden önce sınır koyma çevresinde birleştirir; düzgün ve uygun ölçü vurgusu da bu çekirdeği tamamlar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir nesnenin yapılacak işe göre önceden ölçülüp biçildiği genel bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Ön ölçme ve sınır belirleme işlemlerinin ikisini de korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Deri, kumaş veya benzeri bir nesnenin kesime hazırlanmasını anlatan bağlamlara uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Ölçmenin eylemden önce geldiğini ve kesime yöneldiğini korur.
Önceden bir değer belirleme düşüncesini kısmen korur.
error_profile.loses: Nesneyi ölçme ve uygulama sınırlarını belirleme işlemlerini kaybeder.
error_profile.collision: Belirsiz bir kestirimle ölçüye dayalı hazırlığı birbirine karıştırır.

facets.statement: Yüzey engebesiz, düzgün ve kesintisizdir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak anlatımı sürülerek kullanılan belirli bir hoş koku karışımını ve bunun bedene, kişiye ya da bir yere uygulanmasını birlikte verir. Koku maddesi çekirdektir; sürme ve onunla kokulanma bu maddeye bağlı eylemlerdir.

facets.statement: Mal miktarı kişinin başına denk sayılan bir ölçüyle anlatılır.
Baş ölçüsüne denk mal düşüncesi, kişinin bolluk ve iyi yaşam içinde bulunmasını anlatmaya genişler.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynak anlatımı başa denk sayılan mal ölçüsü ile bu ölçünün bolluk ve iyi yaşam durumu bildiren kullanımını aynı söz kalıbında birleştirir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Yalnız baş ölçüsü çevresinde kurulan kalıp içinde mal miktarını veya kişinin bolluk içindeki durumunu anlatır.

error_profile.preserves: Başla kurulan denkliği, mal miktarını ve bolluk durumuna uzanan kullanımı korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kalıbın bir kişinin başına denk sayılan mal miktarını bildirdiği bağlamda kullanılır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Aynı söz kalıbının mal ölçüsünden çok kişinin iyi ve bol durumunu anlattığı bağlamda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kalıbın kişiye bağlanan bolluk ve iyi yaşam durumunu korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal baş ölçüsüne bağlı sabit söz içinde mal miktarını ve bolluk durumunu anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal iki şey arasındaki genel ölçü, değer, nicelik veya nitelik denkliğini ve eşlik kalıplarını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda da bir miktarın seçilen ölçüyü karşılaması ve ona denk sayılması ilişkisi vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal genel ve üretken denklik alanıdır; odak dal ise yalnız başı ölçü alan kalıpla mal ve bolluk anlatan özel bir kullanımdır.

word_morpheme_spans.note: word_analysis critical words are orthographic/analytic units, not QAC words; each resolves to a MORPHEME SPAN. The upstream aligned_qac_word_ref is preserved verbatim in word_analysis and is NOT corrected here -- renumbering would fabricate identities (PRINCIPLES.md §11 / basmalah no-hidden-renumbering rule). Use word_morpheme_spans for any word-level join to QAC.

word_analysis_qac_alignment.note: aligned_qac_word_ref does NOT resolve against qac_morphemes for this ayah: word-analysis counts orthographic words where QAC counts morphological words. Word-level joins between word_analysis topics and QAC morphology are UNRELIABLE here. Upstream defect in quran-data's word-analysis; deliberately not auto-repaired (renumbering would fabricate identities).

channel_review.note: first-pass blind review by a single reader; no adjudication, no accept/reject, no per-ayah channel maturity. Not a channel ledger.

channel_generated_outputs.note: Generated network-v3 channel discovery/family/path outputs are available as external quran-data files; read them only when channel detail is necessary, and do not treat them as an adjudicated channel ledger.

full_context_packet.note: surah-scope fallback: the default commentary workflow does not consume per-ayah focus packets, so the source packet is scoped by this builder to roots this ayah can justify and carries no staged reveal order

scoping.note: SCOPED, NOT ABSENT. The surah-scope fallback inventory covers every root in the surah; it is narrowed here to roots this ayah can justify -- roots occurring in this ayah (all their branches kept, unconditionally, because Layer 2 selects nothing) plus roots explicitly cited by channel material anchored here (only the cited branches kept, enough to resolve the citation). A root listed in dropped_roots is a deliberate scoping decision, not a missing source.

v12_reader_responses.note: Per-ayah focus-run reader responses are retired from the default commentary workflow. Use regular reader walks, plus/minus-5 reader walks, and cross-run publication findings for corpus-wide reader-derived evidence.

v12_cross_run_publication.note: Compact final cross-run findings for this ayah, reconciled upstream from regular and plus/minus-5 reader runs; use as a coverage/priority check, not as replacement prose.

occurrence_evidence_trim.note: TRIMMED, NOT ABSENT. dictionary_entry.occurrence_evidence.occurrences and .ayahs are removed from every root by design: they are a per-occurrence QAC concordance and character-span alignment table carrying zero readings, branches or senses, and they dominated bundle size (~1.5 MB for a single common root). occurrence_evidence.summary (corpus frequency) and .forms (inflectional inventory) are retained. Dictionary/gloss branches are kept in full for every included Furuq root target.

branch_policy.note: No branch filtering is applied. Every branch present in each included dictionary/gloss root entry is kept.

root_mapping.policy: Use the dominant Furuq root for every QAC root, and include non-dominant Furuq targets as additional root_lexicon entries when qac-furuq-v4-root-map marks the QAC root as split.
